name: API Info
note: Read-only grandMA3 diagnostic that selects the first external drive and exports current API and session/network information to grandMA3/gma3_library/datapools/plugins/APIInfo.
summary: Export grandMA3 API information for plugin development and troubleshooting.

name: Attribute Clone
note: Feature-group folders and native scrolling controls for paired attribute cloning, with a display destination chooser. Sequences, presets and worlds only; groups and layouts excluded.
summary: Clone selected fixture attributes with separate source and destination lists.

name: Auto Color Picker
note: Zero-setup current-Data-Pool color picker. Automatically discovers Groups and Color presets, creates a managed Layout and collision-safe Macros using command-line pool indexes, embeds all runtime code and visual resources, remembers selections per user and Data Pool, and rebuilds only its own objects.
summary: Build a color picker from your Groups and Color presets in the current DataPool.

name: Cue Beacon
note: Cue-driven executor beacon. Adds start/stop commands to cues in the selected sequence and pulses a chosen executor red until the configured stop cue.
summary: Create cue-driven executor beacons with configurable start and stop cues.

name: Hippo Remote
note: Hippo-only Server Command interface for grandMA3 2.5.1: grey device rows with connection outlines, three confirmed OSC operations, preferences, scroll list and display chooser. Utility Plugins.
summary: Server Command's Hippo-only interface for selecting and controlling Hippotizer servers.

name: MA Search
note: Universal Data Pool search with a safe Pool/Sheet result browser, automatic named filtering, highlighted object location, and Clippy assistant.
summary: Find DataPool objects and navigate to them through a dedicated search window.

name: Server Command
note: Session-aware system control for grandMA3 2.5.1, Hippotizer OSC, console and external-drive saves, and a display destination chooser.
summary: Manage Hippotizer servers, consoles and DMX network nodes from your MA3 session.

name: Touch Configurator
note: Touch surface remapping with Original Size or Fit Screen modes, reliable ViewButton transfer, station-local live recall, and transactional stored-View geometry remapping.
summary: Remap touch surfaces and transfer views across your connected displays.

name: Tour Location
note: Searchable worldwide touring-city presets with venue references. Applies session timezone, automatic DST offset, latitude, and longitude; enables and verifies NTP with time.google.com; verifies GlobalMaster authority before reporting success; supports saved defaults and keyboard-only operation.
summary: Set touring locations, session timezone and time synchronization settings.

name: Wing Configurator
note: Identify connected executor-fader surfaces, assign Wing IDs, and automatically reuse the shared Utility Plugins tag.
summary: Identify executor surfaces, assign Wing IDs and organize your desk.

name: WLT Plugin Updator
note: Three-tab updater with per-plugin actions, red/green version cells, all-DataPool destinations and console HTTPS with bundled Mozilla certificates. Utility Plugins.
summary: Scan drives, compare versions, and download or install your Wade plugins.
